verdict.rationale: Ardent ships an official CLI that works from the terminal. It covers creating branches (`ardent branch create`), connecting by printing the connection URL in direct, pooled or prisma form, and inspecting branches (`ardent branch info --format json`), plus connector setup and resume commands. No CLI command is documented for shelling into a database. Missing for 10: a documented shell/psql-into-branch command, evidence the full daily loop runs without the dashboard, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: ardent branch create pr-123 --print-url    # prints only the connection URL
ardent branch info my-feature --format json # prints a stable JSON object
--url-type <type> | Which URL to print: direct (default), pooled, or prisma
Ardent creates instant, isolated copies of your production Postgres database — in seconds, right from your terminal.
